subject: so you want to sell your startup
preview: Most founders go about this the entirely wrong way. Here are the 3 hard truths about early acquisition.
body:
Most founders go about this the entirely wrong way.

Hard truth #1 — you do not sell a company, someone buys it. Every good outcome I have seen started as a relationship built eighteen months before anyone said the word acquisition.

Hard truth #2 — your metrics matter less than your strategic fit.

Hard truth #3 — the second-best acquirer in the room is what sets your price.

More in the full post.
